explanation: The statement says: if multiplication by n is surjective on A, and α : A →+ B kills the n-torsion, then α factors as β ∘ (n•), and also α = n • β. The closest Mathlib tool is AddMonoidHom.liftOfSurjective / liftOfRightInverse in Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Basic.lean. Applied to the map n• : A →+ A, it gives β with β(n•x) = α x, given f.ker ≤ α.ker. Using it would still need a hand-built hom for n•, a proof that its kernel is the n-torsion, an existence step, and a separate proof of the second conclusion α P = n • β P. That is more than a two-line derivation. I found no declaration in Mathlib that states this result directly, so I am answering none_found.
